findings.summary: billable_hours subtracts two aware datetimes sharing the same ZoneInfo object, which ignores UTC offset and uses wall-clock difference, so sessions crossing a DST transition are over- or under-billed by an hour; compute the duration in UTC instead.

judge.reason: Identifies same-tzinfo wall-clock subtraction causing DST mis-billing; fix is UTC.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: The new tests only use July dates with no DST change, so there is no test covering a session spanning a DST boundary (e.g. 2026-03-08 New York or 2026-10-25 Berlin).

judge.reason: Finding that tests fail to cover the DST bug is always valid_other.

findings.label: valid_other
